faqs.question: How do I start a charging session?
faqs.answer:
There are two ways to start a charging session depending on your charger setup:

Method 1 – Plug and Charge: Simply plug the charging cable into your vehicle and the session will start automatically.

Method 2 – VIN Start: Plug in the cable and wait for a red tick to appear on the charger screen. Once the red tick appears, tap the VIN icon on the charger screen to start the session.

faqs.question: What is the red tick on the charger screen?
faqs.answer: The red tick on the charger screen means the charger has detected your vehicle and is ready to start a session. Once you see the red tick, tap the VIN icon on the screen to begin charging.

faqs.question: The red tick is not appearing on the screen, what should I do?
faqs.answer: If the red tick does not appear after plugging in, try the following: Make sure the cable is firmly plugged into both the charger and your vehicle. Ensure your vehicle is switched off and the key is removed from the ignition. Wait up to 60 seconds as some vehicles take time to communicate with the charger. If the red tick still does not appear, please select option 1 from the AE support menu for further assistance.

faqs.question: My vehicle is registered for plug and charge but the session is not starting automatically
faqs.answer: First make sure the cable is firmly plugged into both the charger and your vehicle, and that your vehicle is switched off with the key removed. Some vehicles take up to 60 seconds to initiate plug and charge automatically. If the session still does not start, try the VIN start method as an alternative — plug in, wait for the red tick, and tap your VIN. If neither method works, please select option 1 from the AE support menu.

faqs.question: How do I stop a charging session?
faqs.answer: To stop a charging session, tap the charger screen twice to wake it up, then tap the Stop button that appears on the screen. Once the session has stopped, you can safely unplug the cable from your vehicle.

faqs.question: Can I just unplug the cable to stop charging?
faqs.answer: It is recommended to always stop the session on the charger screen before unplugging. Tap the screen twice to wake it, then tap the Stop button, then unplug. Unplugging without stopping the session first may cause errors on the charger.

faqs.question: The stop button is not responding on the screen, what do I do?
faqs.answer: Try tapping the screen twice again to wake it up, then look for the Stop button. If the screen is unresponsive, please contact support and we will stop the session remotely. Do not forcefully unplug the cable. Please have your Charger ID ready when you contact us.

faqs.question: The session is still showing as active after I stopped it, is that normal?
faqs.answer: It can take up to 2 minutes for the charger to fully close the session after you press stop. If the session still shows as active after 5 minutes, please contact support with your Charger ID and vehicle VIN so we can investigate.

faqs.question: How long should it take to charge my vehicle?
faqs.answer: Charge time depends on your vehicle's battery capacity, current state of charge, and the type of charger at your site. Your fleet manager or Aeversa account team can advise on the expected charge times for your specific vehicle models and charger configuration.

faqs.question: My vehicle is charging slower than usual, what could cause this?
faqs.answer: Several factors can affect charging speed: extreme heat or cold can cause the vehicle's battery management system to reduce charging speed automatically; if the battery is already close to full, charging naturally slows down; peak load periods at the depot may affect available power. If the speed seems unusually low, please select option 3 from the AE support menu.

faqs.question: Can multiple vehicles charge at the same time?
faqs.answer: Yes, multiple vehicles can charge simultaneously at your depot, subject to the number of available charge points and your site's power capacity. Your Aeversa account team will have configured your site to manage load accordingly.

faqs.question: What does kWh mean and why does it matter for our fleet?
faqs.answer: kWh stands for kilowatt-hour and is the unit used to measure energy delivered to your vehicle during a charging session. For fleet management, tracking kWh per vehicle helps monitor energy consumption, calculate charging costs, and identify vehicles that may have battery performance issues.

faqs.question: How do I know which charger to use at my depot?
faqs.answer: Each charger at your depot has a unique Charger ID displayed on a sticker on the unit. Your fleet manager will advise on the correct charger allocation per vehicle. When contacting support, always have the Charger ID ready as it helps us identify and resolve issues faster.

faqs.question: Where do I find the Charger ID?
faqs.answer: The Charger ID is printed on a sticker on the front or side of the charger unit. It is typically a combination of letters and numbers. Please have this ready whenever you contact support as it helps us locate and diagnose your specific charger quickly.

faqs.question: The charger screen is blank or off, what should I do?
faqs.answer: Please select option 2 from the AE support menu and AE will guide you through checking whether this is a power issue at the site or a fault with the specific unit.

faqs.question: There is an error message on the charger screen, what does it mean?
faqs.answer: Error messages on the charger screen usually indicate a communication or hardware fault. Please take note of or photograph the exact error message and contact support via option 1 or option 2 on the AE menu, or email support@aeversa.co.za. Having the Charger ID and error message ready will help us resolve this quickly.

faqs.question: The cable is stuck and I cannot unplug it, what should I do?
faqs.answer: Do not force the cable out. First make sure the charging session has been fully stopped on the charger screen. Some vehicles lock the cable during an active session. If the session is stopped and the cable is still stuck, please contact support immediately and do not attempt to force the connector out as this may damage your vehicle or the charger.

faqs.question: How do I report a vehicle that is consistently not charging properly?
faqs.answer: Please contact support via the AE menu or email support@aeversa.co.za with the vehicle's VIN, the Charger ID it typically uses, and a description of the issue. Our team will investigate whether the fault is with the charger or the vehicle's charging port.

faqs.question: Can I get a report of charging sessions per vehicle?
faqs.answer: Yes, charging session reports per vehicle are available through your Aeversa fleet management account. Please speak to your Aeversa account manager or email support@aeversa.co.za for assistance accessing your reports.

faqs.question: A new vehicle has been added to our fleet, how do we register it on the system?
faqs.answer: New vehicles need to be registered on the Aeversa system before they can charge using the VID start method. Please email support@aeversa.co.za with the vehicle's VID, make, and model and we will get it added for you.

faqs.question: A vehicle has been removed from our fleet, how do we deregister it?
faqs.answer: Please email support@aeversa.co.za with the vehicle's VIN and confirm that it should be removed from your fleet account. We will deactivate it from the system promptly.
